issues.problem: The r3 consent fix (LeanCTX in Pi needs install AND wire) is not applied on the five-tool optimizer's patch-mcp step. With only leanctx wire consent and a user-installed lean-ctx on PATH, optimize-five-tool-stack.sh --host pi (or --host all) enables leanctx in the Pi adapter and appends 'npm:pi-lean-ctx' to ~/.pi/agent/settings.json, so Pi installs an npm package the user never consented to install. In the same run install-leanctx-sb.sh prints 'SKIP: enabling LeanCTX in Pi needs install consent', so the output contradicts what is written. This also contradicts docs/CONSENT.md ('Enabling LeanCTX in Pi needs both wire and install consent'; 'patch-mcp.py ... the caller passes only consented tools'). The commit message claims the fix covers the optimizer.
issues.evidence: REVF-H4b-r4-probe/p1.sh and p2.sh (temp HOME/XDG, stubs for curl/npm/cargo, lean-ctx stub answering --version): grant leanctx=wire; optimize-five-tool-stack.sh --host pi --project-root <proj> --skip-synergy -> rc 0; log: 'SKIP: enabling LeanCTX in Pi needs install consent ...' then 'OK: Pi five-tool adapter installed (leanctx)'; settings.json packages=["npm:pi-lean-ctx"], adapter enabled=["leanctx"]. Same with leanctx=wire,enforce, with graphify=install,wire leanctx=wire, and with --host all. leanctx=install alone or install,wire behave correctly. Without a lean-ctx binary the run stops earlier (install-leanctx-sb exits non-zero), so the bypass needs a self-installed lean-ctx, which the script itself recommends ('or install it yourself: cargo install lean-ctx').
issues.suggested_fix: In optimize_host, for h == pi pass RT_PATCH_LEANCTX=1 only when sb_consent_granted leanctx wire && sb_consent_granted leanctx install (or drop leanctx from the patch-mcp pi branch and leave Pi LeanCTX to install-leanctx-sb.sh); better, enforce it once in patch-mcp.py's pi branch / install-pi.py so no caller can bypass it. Add a test in tests/scripts/test-pi-consent-wiring.sh: leanctx wire-only + stub lean-ctx on PATH -> optimize-five-tool-stack.sh --host pi writes no npm:pi-lean-ctx and does not enable leanctx.
